text:
Dana: Quick sync request — need to lock down how we route 'commit escrow' offers vs graduated retainer deals. Marketplace listing vs direct private contract? Context: compliance teams prefer private for sensitive customers, but sellers want marketplace SKUs for simpler billing.

Raj: my take: use marketplace for standard commits under $250k ARR equivalent. For anything above or that needs KMS/HSM integration, direct private. :thumbsup:

Maria: agree on thresholds, but we need a fallback: if marketplace quota fills, auto-fallback to dedicated private PO. Otherwise we lose deals.

Sam: what about billing cadence? sellers want a retainer-style monthly draw that converts to committed consumption. Marketplace usually expects annual invoicing.

Lucy: we can model a "graduated retainer" SKU in marketplace that maps to our internal retainer contract. It'd be a virtual SKU that reconciles monthly and applies credits at renewal. Ops complexity but doable.

Raj: important: escrow mechanics. Customers want funds escrowed until onboarding completes. Marketplace doesn't support escrow natively. We need a routing rule: if offer requires escrow -> route to direct PO + legal clause.

PartnersBot: NOTE: existing marketplace policies block multi-stage escrow flows. See internal ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/PRT-4821

Dana: ok, so routing rules draft: 1) Escrow required -> direct private PO. 2) >$250k -> direct private PO (can be opt-in to marketplace if seller requests). 3) Graduated retainer under $250k -> marketplace virtual SKU with reconcilation at renewal. 4) If marketplace capacity exhausted -> auto-fallback to private PO and notify seller 24h before failover.

Maria: + consider renewal path: if customer started on marketplace virtual SKU, renewal should surface a renewal script that offers conversion to a standard commit (discount ladder) handled by Partner Success. Need templated renewal messaging.

Sam: can we add telemetry hooks so sales sees conversion-ready signals? e.g., usage >80% of committed band for 60d -> trigger "convert offer" task.

Lucy: yes — Console can emit an alert with route: sales@, partner_ops@, and renewal playbook link. Example: `alert:convert_offer(customer_id, sku, usage_rolling_30d)`

Raj: legal ask: ensure SKU T&Cs reference that marketplace SKU may be transitioned to a private contract at renewal or if escrow required. Need standardized clause. I'll loop in Legal.

Dana: action items: Raj -> draft legal clause for SKU terms (due EOD Friday). Maria -> outline renewal email templates + playbook (due Tue). Lucy -> feasibility doc for virtual SKU reconciliation + effort estimate (due Wed). Sam -> define telemetry thresholds and sample alert payload. I'll own the routing rules and implement canary in staging.

Maria: one more — announcement sequencing: if we list virtual SKU, marketing wants a co-announce with partner channel. That needs 2-week prep and partner signoff. Add to timeline. :calendar:

Dana: noted. Thanks all — I'll create the routing policy PR and tag you.

Sam: thanks, sounds good.

Raj: thanks, pulling Legal in now. :email:

PartnersBot: PR created: https://redwood.internal/prs/7901 — routing-policy/commit-escrow (Dana).
